title: /spec command (spec + plan-review gate)
acceptance_criteria: Emits the spec sections and a plan with per-step verification
Explicitly halts for approval before implementing
goal: A slash command that produces a spec (problem, constraints, acceptance criteria, risks, plan) for a ticket/feature and **stops for plan-review before any code** (doc 02).
notes: Operationalizes "review the plan before code exists." Pairs with `/start-ticket` (spec → approve → start).
